name: Ship Studio
summary: Free, open-source desktop app for agentic development: AI agent terminal, live preview, visual editing, Git and deploys in one window.
description: A free desktop app for macOS and Windows that puts agentic development in one window: run Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode in a built-in terminal, preview and visually edit sites locally, open GitHub branches and PRs, and deploy to Vercel. Comes with 29 starter templates (Next.js, SvelteKit, Astro, Nuxt, Expo, React Native, Flutter) and a projects dashboard.
contains: free, MIT-licensed open-source desktop app for macOS and Windows
AI agent terminal with Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
live preview, visual editing and a Cmd+K command palette
GitHub integration: repo creation, PRs and a merge-conflict UI
one-click deploys to Vercel with auto-deploy on push
29 starter templates: Next.js, SvelteKit, Astro, Nuxt, Expo, React Native, Flutter
mobile app preview on the iOS simulator
plugins, agent skills and MCP support
